name: Luwu

extern-type-declaration.comment: `declare extern type Name<T> extends Base with ... end` from definition files. `declare` and `with` are optional here only so the `extern type Name ... end` summaries shown in hovers highlight too -- they are required in real Luau source.
extern-type-declaration.name: meta.extern-type.luau

declare-function.name: meta.function.declare.luau
declare-function.comment: `declare function name(params): Return` -- a function with no body, from definition files and trait bodies. A trait may mark a declared function optional with `?` after its name: `declare function on_click?(self, cb: Callback)`.

declare-variable.comment: `declare name: Type` -- a global from definition files, or a field a trait requires of its implementers, which may carry the access specifier and `const` of the field (`declare private const id: string`). In a trait the type is optional: `declare cat` means `declare cat: any`.

patterns.comment: Luwu Classes: the access specifier on a class's primary constructor -- `class Account private (holder: User)` -- which qualifies the constructor rather than the class. Only a qualifier when a parameter list follows it.
patterns.name: storage.modifier.access.luau

patterns.comment: Luwu Classes: a primary constructor parameter may carry the access specifier and `const` modifier of the field it implicitly declares, Kotlin-style -- `class SshKey private (public const public_key: string)`. These are only qualifiers when another name follows, so a parameter may still be named `public`, `private` or `const`.
Default value of a primary constructor parameter (`class Name(a = expr)`).
patterns.name: meta.parameter.default.luau

patterns.comment: Not valid Luau syntax -- only used to highlight the POD-constructor field list (`class Name { field: Type, ... }`) shown in class hovers.
patterns.name: meta.table.luau

patterns.comment: Luwu Traits: the traits a class implements, after its header -- `class Heading(level: number) implements Element(`h{level}`), Renderable`. An entry may take generic arguments and trait arguments.
patterns.name: meta.implements.luau

patterns.comment: Luwu Traits: the supertraits a trait needs its implementers to also implement -- `trait Enemy needs Npc<Character>`.

An entry may take generic arguments and trait arguments. This copy picks the list up when it starts a line of its own, below the header.
